changelog:
AEGIS (v8.0.2) - UI polish: no self-resonance, and the card spacing finally works.
- [FIX] The ROGER THAT button is no longer rendered on your own transmissions. Acknowledging your own signal meant nothing; the button is hidden for posts you authored, and ROGER_COUNT stays visible because other stations may legitimately have acknowledged it. Relay-only posts are unaffected - relaying somebody else's signal does not make it yours, so those keep the button.
- [FIX] The action buttons no longer sit flush against the dashed rules. terminal.css never defined the pt-* / pb-* padding utilities, so every one of them in the markup was a silent no-op: measured on the live node, both the QUOTE/PURGE buttons and the ROGER THAT/BOOKMARK buttons sat exactly 1px from the dashed line. The utilities are now declared (values 1-5, mirroring the existing m-*/p-*/py-*/px-* scales), so the intent already present in the markup takes effect: 1px becomes 11px on both edges of the card. This also repairs the same pattern on the public hologram, the bookmarks vault and the direct chat headers.
- [NOTE] pt-0 and pb-0 are deliberately not declared. .t-container-fluid sets padding: 20px and the only two places asking for pt-0 are top-level containers, so honouring it would shift the navbar up by 20px on every page. That is a separate decision, not part of this fix.
- [NOTE] terminal.css is served with a 4 hour Cloudflare edge TTL, so a purge is required for the spacing change to appear immediately. Page output (console.php) is no-store and needs nothing.
- [NOTE] Carries forward the entire v8.0 security overhaul and the v8.0.1 Control Room APPLY button hotfix. See RELEASE_NOTES_v8.0.md and RELEASE_NOTES_v8.0.1.md.
